publications.summary: Responsibility October 27, 2026 The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature The LEGO Group and Sesame Workshop, the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street, have launched three new videos, funded by the LEGO Foundation, encouraging children aged 4 to 6 to discover the natural world through play. publications.title: My LEGO 'Fear'
publications.summary: Happy Hallowe'en! There are many things to fear in LEGO sets, from expensive prices and poor colour matching to agonisingly descriptive set names and the recently-revealed 67012 The Joker Wall Art Comic Cover. However, I encountered something else I really dislike while constructing 75645 Battle at Drum Castle yesterday: the dreaded 'sticker applied on the inside of a wall panel'! These are occasionally a necessary feature, where space is at an absolute premium, but I find them annoying for a number of reasons. Chief among them is that I think such details can be brick-built in the vast majority of cases and that is certainly the case with the shelves in Drum Castle. Also, they are tricky stickers to apply because it can be easy to trap dust or air bubbles underneath and you only have one chance to place them, as you cannot reach the corners to lift them for another attempt, trapped inside the panel as they are. Even worse is the horrifying 'sticker applied on the inside of a curved wall panel', but those are fortunately quite rare nowadays. I still remember my apprehension placing a sticker on the inside of an 8x4x6 half cone element in 76387 Hogwarts: Fluffy Encounter! Do you have any LEGO fears like mine? Let us know in the comments. © 2026 Brickset.com . Republication prohibited without prior permission.

publications.title: Ninth Panel: A new display case company launched this week
publications.summary: The LEGO display-case market has grown considerably in recent years, with collectors now able to choose from a wide range of attractive, set-specific displays. However, the experience surrounding those products has not always kept pace. Lengthy lead times, uncertain dispatch dates and slow customer service remain common frustrations. Today, we are delighted to announce a new partnership with Ninth Panel , a founder-led company aiming to raise the standard in these areas, and a limited-time discount for Brickset on its first products. The company launched earlier this week in the UK with its first two display cases available now and is preparing to begin domestic US fulfilment from its facility in Lakeland, Florida, on 16 November. Its approach combines thoughtful set-specific products with finished stock, prompt customer care and a closer relationship with the collectors buying them. Continue reading » © 2026 Brickset.com . Republication prohibited without prior permission.
